beloong.advancement.beloong/adventure_be: Return to the Overworld from the Loong Palace. The real adventure starts now.
beloong.advancement.beloong/air_strike_k: Kill an enemy using the skill [Air Strike].
beloong.advancement.beloong/combat_train: Kill an iron golem by any means.
beloong.advancement.beloong/dragon_curse: Upgrade the passive ability Qi Concentration to its maximum level.
beloong.advancement.beloong/finish_begin: Complete the Beginner Tutorial to unlock other dragon types.
The kingdom of mankind — the Netherlands.
beloong.advancement.beloong/item_restric: Drop or pick up a shield, and learn the equipment limits of dragons.
beloong.advancement.beloong/my_claw_is_n: Equip a sword in your claw slot, and your dragon claws grow sharper.
beloong.advancement.beloong/root.desc: Become a loong and start your journey!
beloong.advancement.beloong/skip_beginne: Although the Beginner Tutorial can be skipped, it is still recommended to complete it carefully.
Kill a pig using Dragon Breath.
beloong.advancement.beloong/wind_sword.d: Kill a creeper using Wind Sword.
beloong.advancement.npc/3_0.desc: Meet the Loong King "Di" in the depths of the Loong Palace.
beloong.advancement.npc/3_1.desc: Hear the Loong King "Di" tell of the prophecy of the Dragon-Blooded Child.
beloong.dialogue.dihuang_loong.name: §6Di
beloong.dialogue.dihuang_loong.p1: I am the lord of the Loong Palace, sovereign of all under heaven, titled "§eDi§r".
beloong.dialogue.dihuang_loong.p2: Young friend, you carry the blood of dragons within you. The resurgence of our kind is within sight!
beloong.dialogue.dihuang_loong.reply1: §eWhat business do you have with me?
beloong.chatbox.dihuang_loong.name: §6Di
beloong.chatbox.dihuang_loong.p1: Your Dragon Mother entrusted you to me, hoping I would watch over you in her stead.
beloong.chatbox.dihuang_loong.p2:
Though you wear human form, you bear the blood of dragons — you can awaken as a true loong!
§7(At this, "§eDi§7"'s voice grows impassioned)
beloong.chatbox.dihuang_loong.p3:
The Ancestral Dragon once prophesied: when the Dragon-Blooded Child appears, our kind shall surely be saved from fire and water!
§7("§eDi§7" studies you closely, filled with joy)
beloong.chatbox.dihuang_loong.aw1: Leap into the §3Dragon Pool§r, and you shall become a true loong. "§5Mo§r" will take you there.
beloong.chatbox.dihuang_loong.sv1: You are still weak as yet. Once you leap into the §3Dragon Pool§r, you shall ride the wind and become a loong! "§5Mo§r" will take you there.
beloong.advancement.npc/4_1.desc: Follow "Mo" to the Dragon Pool behind the Loong Palace.
beloong.dialogue.mo.lead.p1: The Loong King has entrusted your matter to me. Come, I will take you to the Dragon Pool.
beloong.chatbox.mo_pool.name: §dMo
beloong.chatbox.mo_pool.p1: The §3Dragon Pool§r lies on the §dLoong Immortal Isle§r behind the Loong Palace.
beloong.chatbox.mo_pool.p2: The §dLoong Immortal Isle§r was a mountain range the Loong King cut from the birthplace of dragonkind with great magic, and raised whole into the heavens.
beloong.chatbox.mo_pool.p3: Follow me. The road is long, so I shall speed up.
beloong.advancement.npc/5_1.desc: Become a true loong and take up the Yongle Canon your father left behind.
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.name: §dMo
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.p1: Yes. Dragons often come here for baptism — I used to play here all the time as a child.
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.p2: Alas, times have changed. The weeds around here have grown taller than you are...
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.opt_splash: §eSo if I just jump into the water, I'll become a loong?
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.p3: Yes. You are a descendant of the Aether Dragon "§3Qing§r", so the §3Aether Dragon§r bloodline is the first to awaken in you.
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.opt_what: §eWhat kind of dragon is the §3Aether Dragon§e?
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.p4: The §3Aether Dragon§r is an ancient Chinese dragon that can swallow clouds and breathe mist, and commands the magic of wind.
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.p5: This lineage has grown sparse — after the great war, scarcely any remain. So you must grow strong, and not disappoint the hopes dragonkind places in you.
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.p6: Go on. I will wait for you here.
beloong.chatbox.pool_talk.opt_soar: §eThen I'll ride the clouds and mist!
beloong.chatbox.dragon_talk.name: §dMo
beloong.chatbox.dragon_talk.p2: My task here is finished. I must take my leave.
beloong.chatbox.dragon_talk.p3: The §6Yongle Canon§r in your hands was compiled by your father — it is also called the §6Task Book§r. Open it, and it will teach you what to do next.
beloong.chatbox.dragon_talk.p4: I have other matters to attend to. I shall go on ahead.
